bio.text: Amanda Gonzalez is the Democratic nominee for Colorado Secretary of State in 2026 and currently serves as Jefferson County Clerk and Recorder.
According to her campaign website, she is an election attorney who previously served as executive director of Colorado Common Cause and has taught election law at the University of Denver.
Her campaign says she calls Jefferson County home.

sources.title: Commissioner Zenzinger: Making Your Voice Heard This Election Season
